name: Korsana Biosciences Inc. Common Stock
summary: Cyclerion Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of human therapeutics. Its product pipeline includes several sGC stimulators, small molecules that act synergistically with nitric oxide on sGC to boost production of cyclic guanosine monophosphate. The company was founded on September 6, 2018 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
